Second-year students can apply to Twitter Academy, which is a 12-week summer internship designed for historically underrepresented second-year computer science students (black, Hispanic/Latinx and/or Native American) interested in gaining hands-on and real-life experience in the tech industry. To learn more please check out the above programs section. I’ve already interned at Twitter once. Can I apply for another opportunity later? Absolutely. I applied and didn’t get it — what now?
